verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly documents percentage rollouts and progressive rollouts, plus guarded rollouts and scheduled flag changes for ramping exposure over time. A community user independently confirms custom rollout by percentage of users. Another notes that clients stream flag changes, which supports ramping without redeploying. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of consistent/sticky bucketing (hashing on context key), and detail beyond page titles on ramp granularity from 1% to 100%.
